tell: Wheat on middling ground a walk from water: the best bread for the work, but it wants the soil rested and hates cold, wet and flood.
suits: clamp(1 - abs(parcel.water - 3) / 5, 0, 1) * (1 - 0.8 * field.flood) * (1 - field.snow) * clamp(1 - abs(field.damp - 0.5) * 1.5, 0, 1) * clamp(parcel.elevation / 3, 0, 1) * clamp(1 - (parcel.elevation - 25) / 15, 0, 1)
